identity.statusNote: fellow.app now redirects (301) to fellow.ai; the product itself is unchanged.

freePlan.limits: 5 AI notes lifetime, 5 AI recordings lifetime, up to 5 seats.

keyLimits.en: 10 AI notes/user/month, 10 AI recordings/user, meeting automations, project management integrations, up to 20 seats.
Unlimited AI notes and recordings, sales AI templates, org-wide meeting templates, advanced CRM integration (Salesforce, HubSpot), up to 50 seats.
Minimum 10 users, custom contracts; third-party guidance suggests around $25/user/month billed annually, advanced recording permissions, domain control, user provisioning, security reviews.

cautions.en: Free plan AI note and recording quotas are lifetime totals (5 each), not monthly, so they are consumed quickly for regular meeting use.

capabilities.en: AI meeting assistant with collaborative agendas, automated notes and transcription, and action-item tracking.
Integrates with Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Slack for meeting capture, plus Confluence and Notion for notes on paid plans.
CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot) and API access on Business and above for syncing meeting data into sales workflows.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at lifetime totals of 5 AI notes and 5 AI recordings, not renewed monthly.
API access and advanced CRM integrations require the Team plan or above; not available on the free tier.

reason.en: Direct competitor offering free AI meeting notes and recordings with similar calendar/video integrations.
AI meeting notes tool aimed at the same use case of automated notetaking during calls.
General workspace that can host meeting notes and action items, an alternative for teams not needing dedicated meeting AI.
